title: SCAM! Stay away from this app
body:
Multiple unexpected charges appeared on my bank account, yet customer support claims they cannot find any subscription linked to me. I was charged four times in total and I have now lost over a 100€ to this scamming app. I am a student. This is a very large sum for me and I need it back badly. Being charged without a traceable subscription is unacceptable and extremely concerning. 

This app presents itself as a mental health and self-improvement platform that is supposed to support people who may already be feeling vulnerable. That makes my experience even more disappointing.
author: IvanaMarc

title: Overwhelming, distracting, weird subscription.
body: The app is overwhelming as hell, it always bombards you with pop ups and animations, cluttered home page, there are 6 other apps with this, which would not infuriate me if I did not accidentally activate subscriptions on them too because of the predatory subscription system that tells you you will pay X and then suddenly you pay Y due to a skip offer button being greyed out intentionally to make you purchase a 25 dollar subscription by accident. Cancelling your membership is another thing too and I had to contact support to even cancel it as It is almost impossible in app or website. Either giving me an error or the cancell button literally MISSING from the website where the guide shows you it should be. The support was swift however and they resolved the issue for me quickly, for that I give another star.

title: scammers
body:
I have a terrible experience, I gave them 1 € for a free trial, I canceled the subscription right after reading all the terms of these, I did it through the website. Today after a month, when I completely forgot about the app, I was charged 55 € for what!! I remember that I canceled manually because I was horrified by its price.

After going to the website I see my 39.99 subscribers. it was canceled but there were others for 55 €???? sorry? another big problem: after canceling this expensive program I got everything that is written on the screenshot - it expires in March??? I canceled it in January and they wanted to cheat me for 2 months? what is this is inhuman. I immediately deactivated and deleted my account and got an email saying that if there was a subscription I still got my money. I apologize?? So I don't have an account but I still get paid? I reached out and tried to explain and it turned out I only knew 250 characters. - like 4 sentences. I got an email saying FINALLY the whole thing - which was completely cancelled, that I had to email them and it should have been done on the website in the first place!

I now have PTSD that I'm still getting paid. DO NOT RECOMMEND!!!!!!!!
